_about: Hand-verified ground truth for Duluth UDC tables, read from rendered page images on 2026-08-14. This is the regression fixture: an extractor run must reproduce n_cols, header and n_rows exactly, or the build fails. Source: UDC_ADOPTED_9.8.2025_Amended_7-13-26.pdf, sha256 2311ae985c3f1e46cb84844fdb09bfe92b89917572e112c29b78cb9fe94a48c0, Last-Modified 2026-07-16.
_method: Each table was rendered at 200 dpi and transcribed by eye. Automated extraction was NOT trusted for any value here. ROW CONVENTION: n_rows counts RULED rows. A subdivision drawn inside a cell is not a row -- it stays in the cell, its parts separated by newlines. Table 9-A row 6 is one ruled row whose label cell reads "Local Street / Non-residential / Non-residential Cul-de-sac" against two value pairs; splitting it on lines would produce two rows with no values at all. Measured against the drawn rules: a real row boundary in these tables spans 0.75-1.00 of the table width, an in-cell division spans 0.11-0.34. The counts for 2-C (both), 2-D p89 and 4-B were null until 2026-08-17, when the cell-verification pass counted ruled rows per page against the renders and reconciled them with the stored indices; 2-D p89's page_to was corrected 94 -> 93 in the same pass (p94 carries no table -- Article Three begins there, verified on the render).
